item.title: Fishing & Animal Taming in 99 Nights in the Forest
item.description: Fishing is the most famous side activity in 99 Nights in the Forest — because it hides a working chat code. Taming is the animal companion system that helps gatherers and scouts. Fishing — unlock and use Upgrade your Campfire to level 2. Craft/obtain the fishing rod. Go to a fishing spot and cast the rod into the water. Wait for the bite, then reel in. item.title: Forest Rage Hard Mode in 99 Nights in the Forest — Corruption, Rifts & Research Outpost
item.description: Forest Rage is the hard-mode layer of 99 Nights in the Forest — reached after the main run, it raises threat scaling and adds the Corruption mechanic, Rift clearing and the Research Outpost end-game objective. ⚠ In progress: This guide is part of the writing queue — the systems below are the confirmed direction (Corruption / Rift clearing / Research Outpost) with the detailed numbers and strats being verified. Treat everything as framework content for now.

item.title: Modifier Flames in 99 Nights in the Forest — What They Do and How to Use Them
item.description: Modifier Flames are upgrade items that attach to your weapons and tools to change how they behave. They’re one of the main reasons late-game loadouts feel completely different from early-game ones. What Flames do Modify equipment — attach to a weapon/tool to change its properties (damage type, effects, resource yield). Stack with tiers — a good Flame on an upgraded weapon beats a plain top-tier weapon. Are random — code rewards like forestwakesup26 grant random Flames, so collection is part of the loop.

item.title: Weapons & Tools in 99 Nights in the Forest — Crafting Tiers and Loadouts
item.description: Your crafting bench is the whole economy of 99 Nights in the Forest. Everything you survive with — tools, weapons, armor, map and compass — comes out of it, and its upgrade level gates what you can build. Crafting bench tiers (framework) The bench upgrades unlock recipe groups in order. The exact item names and material costs shift with updates — this is the progression shape, not a fixed price table.
